title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyperparameter lambda (λ).

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: Increasing the value of lambda (λ) in ridge regression affects the estimated parameters. Consider how regularization impacts the model's complexity.

title: Impact on Estimated Parameters
text: As lambda (λ) increases, the regularization term becomes more significant. This affects the estimated parameters (θ).
